manifest.name: dsh-wsl-kit
manifest.description: The WSL side of DeepSeek Harness in one install: one bundle that pulls in the whole dsh-wsl-* set.

bundle.text:
# dsh-wsl-kit — ready profile rows
# Append to your DeepSeek Harness profile cordis.patch.yml after installing the plugins.
# Install plugins first (see README); this file only configures them.

- insert:
    - id: dsh-wsl-env
      name: dsh-wsl-env
      config:
        when: wsl
        order: 15
        extraNotes: ""

    - id: dsh-wsl-net
      name: dsh-wsl-net
      config:
        timeoutMs: 20000
        probeTimeoutMs: 5000
        injectChildProxy: true

    - id: dsh-wsl-fetch
      name: dsh-wsl-fetch
      config:
        timeoutMs: 30000
        maxRedirects: 5
        retries: 2

    - id: dsh-wsl-open
      name: dsh-wsl-open
      config:
        enabled: true

    - id: dsh-repeat-stop
      name: dsh-repeat-stop
      config:
        enabled: true
        threshold: 6
        exclude:
          - job_output
          - job_list
          - job_kill

    - id: dsh-tool-budget
      name: dsh-tool-budget
      config:
        enabled: true
        maxCalls: 80
        exclude:
          - job_output
          - job_list
          - job_kill

    - id: dsh-wsl-clipboard
      name: dsh-wsl-clipboard
      config:
        timeoutMs: 15000
        maxChars: 100000

    - id: dsh-wsl-launch
      name: dsh-wsl-launch
      config:
        timeoutMs: 20000

    - id: dsh-wsl-path
      name: dsh-wsl-path
      config: {}

    - id: dsh-wsl-gpu
      name: dsh-wsl-gpu
      config:
        timeoutMs: 20000

    - id: dsh-wsl-port
      name: dsh-wsl-port
      config:
        timeoutMs: 15000
        defaultPort: 3080

    - id: dsh-wsl-distro
      name: dsh-wsl-distro
      config:
        timeoutMs: 15000

    - id: dsh-wsl-cred
      name: dsh-wsl-cred
      config:
        timeoutMs: 10000

    - id: dsh-wsl-github
      name: dsh-wsl-github
      config:
        timeoutMs: 20000
        appId: ""
        privateKeyPath: ""
        installationId: ""

    - id: dsh-wsl-notify
      name: dsh-wsl-notify
      config:
        timeoutMs: 30000
        maxLen: 500

    - id: dsh-wsl-browser
      name: dsh-wsl-browser
      config:
        timeoutMs: 15000

    - id: dsh-wsl-workspace
      name: dsh-wsl-workspace-check
      config:
        timeoutMs: 15000

    - id: dsh-wsl-picker
      name: dsh-wsl-picker
      config:
        timeoutMs: 15000
        maxEntries: 200

    - id: dsh-wsl-tray
      name: dsh-wsl-tray-launcher
      config:
        timeoutMs: 30000

    - id: dsh-wsl-expose
      name: dsh-wsl-portproxy
      config:
        timeoutMs: 30000
        defaultPort: 3080

    - id: dsh-wsl-hostsvc
      name: dsh-wsl-hostsvc
      config:
        timeoutMs: 15000

    - id: dsh-wsl-clock
      name: dsh-wsl-clock
      config:
        timeoutMs: 15000
        maxSkewSec: 30

    - id: dsh-wsl-dns
      name: dsh-wsl-dns
      config:
        timeoutMs: 20000

    - id: dsh-wsl-mnt
      name: dsh-wsl-mnt
      config:
        timeoutMs: 10000

    - id: dsh-wsl-editor
      name: dsh-wsl-editor
      config:
        timeoutMs: 20000

    - id: dsh-wsl-shot
      name: dsh-wsl-shot
      config:
        timeoutMs: 30000

    - id: dsh-wsl-docker
      name: dsh-wsl-docker
      config:
        timeoutMs: 20000

    - id: dsh-wsl-ssh-agent
      name: dsh-wsl-ssh-agent
      config:
        timeoutMs: 15000

    - id: dsh-wsl-encoding
      name: dsh-wsl-encoding
      config:
        timeoutMs: 15000

    - id: dsh-wsl-wslconfig
      name: dsh-wsl-wslconfig
      config:
        timeoutMs: 10000

    - id: dsh-wsl-download
      name: dsh-wsl-download
      config:
        timeoutMs: 30000

readme.text:
**One line:** DeepSeek Harness agent in WSL, chat in a Windows browser — install this kit when paths, proxy, clipboard, and “open that file” must cross the OS boundary.

This is a **meta-repo** (docs + install script + [`cordis.patch.yml`](./cordis.patch.yml)). It does not ship plugin runtimes. Each plugin repo ships a homepage `README.md` (often Chinese-first for newer plugins) plus `README.en.md` / `README.zh.md` as needed.

[中文说明 → README.zh.md](./README.zh.md)

---

The kit is not a runtime. `install.sh` loads **Daily / GitHub / LLM / Full** plugins into the dsh `web` profile. Chat stays on Windows; the agent and tools stay in WSL. A second tier of **Linux/local capability** plugins (inference, search, media, read-only DevOps, …) is **not** in `install.sh` — use [`link-linux-plugins.sh`](./scripts/link-linux-plugins.sh) or `dsh plugin add` as needed. IM / Obsidian / Jev are likewise off `install.sh`.

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  subgraph win [Windows]
    browser["Browser :3081/?token="]
    host["Clipboard / Explorer / default browser"]

| Boundary | Who owns it |
|----------|-------------|
| Windows UI | Browser on `:3081` with a one-shot `?token=` (bare `:3081` is 401; `:3080` is WSL-only) |
| Agent | `dsh web` inside WSL, tools via plugin `ctx` |
| Cross-OS Daily | `path` / `open` / `clipboard` / `browser` / `launch` / `net` / `fetch` (`KIT_SET=daily`) |
| Linux local optional | Inference, media, sandboxed search, secrets, read-only DevOps — see [`docs/OPTIONAL_PLUGINS.md`](./docs/OPTIONAL_PLUGINS.md); `bash scripts/link-linux-plugins.sh` |
| IM | `dsh-wsl-im` outbound WS/Stream/Gateway → `ctx.agents`. One workspace per IM, one session per chat |
| Obsidian | `dsh-wsl-obsidian`: WSL agent ↔ Windows NTFS vault + `obsidian://` |
| Jev | `dsh-wsl-jev`: System One (`jev_ask` / `check` / `rank`) via OpenRouter or TypeSafe |

readme.section: The bundle package, and why `install.sh` is still the way in
readme.text:
There is a `package.json` here that describes the same 31 plugins as one bundle
(`dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`, which carries their `config`). **It does not install today**, and
the reason is worth knowing before you try it:

```
pnpm add github:173787247/dsh-wsl-kit
  → ERR_PNPM_EXOTIC_SUBDEP: Exotic dependency "dsh-wsl-tray-launcher" (resolved via
    git-repository) is not allowed in subdependencies when blockExoticSubdeps is enabled
```

readme.section: The bundle package, and why `install.sh` is still the way in
readme.text:
pnpm refuses a git-resolved dependency inside another git-resolved package. A `github:` bundle therefore
cannot depend on `github:` plugins — so the bundle only becomes installable once the plugins are **on npm**,
at which point its dependencies become ordinary version ranges.

Until then: **use [`install.sh`](./install.sh)** (or `dsh plugin add` per plugin). The `package.json` is the
description of the destination, not a second route to it.

> **Three plugins install under a different name than their repository.** npm already had
> `dsh-wsl-tray`, `dsh-wsl-expose` and `dsh-wsl-workspace` taken by other authors' plugins, so these
> three publish under `dsh-wsl-tray-launcher`, `dsh-wsl-portproxy` and `dsh-wsl-workspace-check`.
> The repositories are unchanged — only `dsh plugin add` needs the package name. Everything else on
> this page links to the repository, which is what you clone or read.

| Piece | Status |
|-------|--------|
| **dsh** | Verified against **`0.2.2-rc.1`** (2026-11-05). rc.1 syncs Cordis Core 4.1.0, Loader 1.1.0, and Include 1.1.0. The WSL plugin suite needs no source change: all 71 plugin `lib/` entry points import under rc.1, and the full `web` profile boots with every bundle enabled and no compatibility errors. `dsh-experimental-tool-worktree` remains merged into change requests/worktrees; remove it from profile bundles if present. Kit scripts assume dsh **≥0.1.2** UI launch tokens (`?token=` on `:3081`). The `{{cwd}}` placeholder in [dsh-wsl-env](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-env) is gone. |
| **DeepSeek V4.1 Flash** | Official API model id is **`deepseek-flash`**. Legacy `deepseek-v4-flash` / `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` temporarily route to V4.1 Flash. **Not configured by this kit** — set under `llm-deepseek` / default model in `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`. |
| **Agent Teams** | Opt-in experimental package (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile`, same line as your dsh). **Not** part of `install.sh`. Expect longer “Deep diving” turns; use a fresh non-Teams session to smoke-test models. |
| **Plugins** | Snapshot: [Plugin versions](
These hit things in this kit. **Read this before upgrading**, not after the UI stops working.

| Change | Impact | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| **`{{cwd}}` is no longer a prompt variable** | The official `dsh-system-prompt` README states the loop does not register it. Leaving it in a prompt makes assembly **fail** — every message reports `unknown prompt variable` and the UI looks dead | Use plain prose. The working directory now comes from runtime context and the new `working_directory` tool. [dsh-wsl-env](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-env) is fixed (`a674c70`) |
| **`agent-instructions` drops per-line `dshHome` config** | Instruction directories now come from the process's `DSH_HOME` or the default | Check the profile patch for a `dshHome` entry under `agent-instructions` and remove it |
| **Tool display `both` mode removed** | Only `native` and `ptc` remain | Update old configs and API calls |
| **Agent Team messages go straight to the target Inbox** | The standalone outbox, auto-retry and resend dedup are gone | Config and result fields need migrating |
| **Python PTC now uses the session sandbox policy** | Custom compositions must provide `sandbox` and `sandboxPolicy` services | Add them to hand-made compositions |
| **Default SDK profile is now a general AI Agent

**What you gain**: the `working_directory` tool, shared `AGENTS.md` from an agents directory (`DSH_AGENTS_HOME`), an experimental Git Worktrees plugin, session state-record APIs, Web binding to a chosen address with native HTTPS, pi-ai 1.0.2.

**One habit**: read the release notes' "Other changes" section before upgrading — every breaking change lives there. We upgraded first and read afterwards, and paid for it with a night of debugging.

Read from the upstream release notes on 2026-10-16, after upgrading to alpha.4 without
reading them first. The one change that mattered was a single line under **Other changes**.

| Version | Change | Impact | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| **alpha.4** | Plugin compatibility is decided by **`engines.dsh`** when a plugin declares it | A plugin declaring a range narrower than the core is **disabled outright**: `disabling profile plugin row "<id>": Plugin <pkg>@<old> is incompatible with dsh <new>`. It is not an error you see — the tools and panels are simply absent | Keep pinned `@deepseek-ai/*` plugins on the **same version track** as the core: `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <pkg>@<version>` |
| **alpha.3** | Credential precedence changed: Web and Desktop prefer **saved** credentials; headless uses environment and `.env` and **no longer reads saved keys** | A headless profile that relied on a saved key stops authenticating | Give headless an explicit key through the environment or `.env` |
| **alpha.3** | The Azure provider is now named **`azure`** | Provider configs still using `azure-openai-responses` stop resolving | Rename the provider |
| **alpha.3** | `--from-default-profile` now **replaces** the target custom profile, including its plugins and settings | Running it against a profile you care about destroys that profile's plugin set | Back the profi

**How to check the second row for yourself**

```sh
grep 'disabling profile plugin row' /tmp/dsh-web.log     # a plugin was disabled at startup
```

The log is appended across restarts, so count the lines **before** upgrading and compare
afterwards — a bare `grep -c` reports every past start as well.

**No breaking change.** Its "Other changes" adds one slot,
`conversation.input.model.label`, for plugins that relabel the composer's model
selector. Nothing in this kit is affected.

Recorded so the next upgrade does not have to re-derive it — and because the two
releases before it *did* break things.

readme.section: Upgrading, and what keeps the UI reachable
readme.text:
Use `scripts/upgrade-dsh-full.sh`; it reads the target release's notes before it
installs anything, and `docs/UPGRADE.zh.md` describes the layers and the traps.

Two scripts exist so a broken UI does not need a person at the keyboard:

readme.section: Upgrading, and what keeps the UI reachable
readme.text:
| | |
|---|---|
| `scripts/dsh-web-watchdog.sh` | Probes the port on a timer and revives only when it is down; anything already answering is left alone |
| `scripts/dsh-rescue.sh` | Last resort. Assumes neither systemd nor the rest of this kit is intact, falls back to starting dsh directly |

readme.section: Plugin README policy### Plugin README policy
readme.text:
- **This Compatibility section is the suite matrix.** Each plugin README has a matching **Compatibility** table (EN + ZH): minimum dsh **≥0.1.2**, pointer here for **latest verified**, kit set, and notes that cloud Flash / Agent Teams are not owned by WSL plugins.
- When dsh ships a new line (e.g. `0.1.5` GA or `0.1.6`), **update this kit table first**, then refresh plugin “currently …” lines (or re-run the suite doc sync). Do not invent per-plugin “verified” dates without a smoke pass.
- API-sensitive plugins (`net`, `fetch`, `port`, `expose`, `tray`, `hostsvc`) carry an extra **Scope** paragraph; thinner Daily tools keep the shared table only.

readme.section: Plugin README policy### Plugin README policy
readme.text:
No kit code change is required solely for V4.1 Flash — update model ids in settings if you still default to retired names.

---

**Prereq:** `dsh` works inside WSL (profile usually `web`). Prefer `0.2.2-rc.1` or newer from the same train.

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-kit/master/install.sh \
  | KIT_SET=daily bash
```

Then:

1. Restart via [`scripts/restart-dsh-web.sh`](./scripts/restart-dsh-web.sh) (starts dsh on `:3080` **and** the Windows relay on `:3081`)
2. In Windows open the **URL printed by `restart-dsh-web.sh`** (dsh ≥0.1.2 includes `?token=`; bare `:3081` is 401. Not `:3080`). Token is also written to `/tmp/dsh-ui-url` (WSL).
3. Open a **new** session (old sessions keep the old toolset)
4. Optionally merge [`cordis.patch.yml`](./cordis.patch.yml) into your profile (a later plugin `config` **replaces** the whole object — restate every key you still need)

| Want | Command |
|------|---------|
| **Daily (recommended)** | `KIT_SET=daily bash install.sh` |
| Daily + GitHub App / credentials | `KIT_SET=github bash install.sh` |
| **Local LLM + network doctor** | `KIT_SET=llm bash install.sh` |
| Everything | `KIT_SET=full bash install.sh` (or omit `KIT_SET` — same as before) |

From a local clone: `KIT_SET=daily bash install.sh`

- `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1`, `OLLAMA_API_KEY` default `ollama`
- `NO_PROXY=127.0.0.1,localhost` only (do **not** inherit Clash RFC1918 `NO_PROXY` globs — they make Node skip the proxy and timeout on `api.deepseek.com`)
- Optional: `source "$HOME/.dsh/dsh-wsl-github.env"` yourself before start when using GitHub App plugins

---

| Pain | Tool | Plugin |
|------|------|--------|
| Proxy / Node 24 blocks DeepSeek or npm | `net_doctor` | [dsh-wsl-net](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-net) |
| `web_fetch` `TypeError: fetch failed` (API works) | Install [dsh-wsl-fetch](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-fetch) ≥0.1.1 + `restart-dsh-web.sh` | [dsh-wsl-fetch](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-fetch) |
| Open a Linux path from chat on Windows | (clickable paths) | [dsh-wsl-open](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-open) |
| Path convert / slow `/mnt/c` | `path_convert` | [dsh-wsl-path](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-path) |
| Windows clipboard | `wsl_clipboard` | [dsh-wsl-clipboard](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-clipboard) |
| Open a PR / docs URL in Windows | `win_open_url` | [dsh-wsl-browser](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-browser) |
| Agent forgets it is in WSL | (system prompt inject) | [dsh-wsl-env](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-env) |

**Daily** = table above + `win_launch` + `dsh-repeat-stop` + `dsh-tool-budget` + **`dsh-wsl-fetch`**.

Smoke: in a new session ask “run `net_doctor`” and “copy this path to the Windows clipboard”. Prefer model **`deepseek-flash`** for cloud; keep Agent Teams off for first smoke.

---

| Set | Includes | Who |
|-----|----------|-----|
| **Daily** | env, net, **fetch**, open, repeat-stop, tool-budget, clipboard, path, browser, launch | Most WSL + Windows-browser users |
| **GitHub day** | Daily + [github](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-github) + [cred](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-cred) + notify | Also need PR/Actions status and `git push` credential hints |
| **LLM** | env, net, **fetch**, hostsvc, docker, dns, clock, gpu, port, expose, tray, open, path, browser | Local Ollama / vLLM / Unsloth + connectivity |
| **Full** | Everything in [`install.sh`](./install.sh) — Daily + GitHub extras + doctors, plus read-only Windows host observation (perf, service, eventlog, registry, defender, power) | GPU/Docker/clock doctors, tray, portproxy, etc. |
| **Desktop** | uia, winshot, winctl, wininput — `KIT_SET=desktop` | Want the agent to read **and drive** the Windows desktop |

**Do not** start with Full — get Daily working, then add plugins for specific pains.

**Desktop is a separate set on purpose.** `dsh-wsl-wininput` types and clicks,
`dsh-wsl-winctl` moves and closes windows; `dsh-wsl-uia` and `dsh-wsl-winshot`
are the observation half of the same pair. That is a different power level from
reading counters and an event log, so `full` never pulls it in.

GitHub from WSL is credentials + API + browser open + proxy — not one mega-plugin. After `KIT_SET=github`:

1. Create the App per [dsh-wsl-github](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-github#readme) (read-only Metadata / PRs / Actions; webhooks off)
2. Before start: `source "$HOME/.dsh/dsh-wsl-github.env"`
3. New session → `github_app_hint` / `github_repo_status`; **never** paste PEM / PAT into chat

---

```sh
export HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7890   # or Clash mixed port, e.g. 16006
export HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7890
export NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1

readme.section: Prefer restart-dsh-web.sh so NO_PROXY stays loopback-only
readme.text:
```

Still failing → ask the agent to run `net_doctor`.

- **API works, `web_fetch` fails** → [dsh-wsl-fetch](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-fetch) (Daily already installs it).
- **Third-party Workers / Cloudflare 403 (1010) via Clash** → add a **DIRECT** rule for that host (plugin cannot override site WAF).

readme.section: Prefer restart-dsh-web.sh so NO_PROXY stays loopback-only
readme.text:
